_note: Wallbang rules shared by the game (index.html PEN) and the server (anticheat/data/penetration.json). path = metres the bullet travels INSIDE the solid (so a shallow angle is a longer path); crate-type boxes use a flat 'flat' metres (two thin skins). A shot passes only when path <= max * power; damage multiplier = 1 - path*cost/power (must stay >= minMult). Concrete, rock, towers and bunkers have no material = they block.
_paper: Foldiers wallbang classes: card = thin cardboard (<= 20 cm: all guns, flat 10 cm path), card2 = double card (<= 45 cm: sniper + rifle; SMG and shotgun stop), crate = hollow box (two skins), wood = ruler / trusses; pencils, clips, metal, floors and thick blocks stop bullets. Tearable panels: real holes, bullets carry on at 60 % (TEAR.R.throughK).

holes._note: HOLES_SYSTEM.md B2: per-gun holes in thin card (P1). entry/exit = hole radius in mm; thinK = damage left per thin-card layer (flat, any angle); maxLayers = thin panels a bullet passes (the next one stops it). A ray through an EXISTING opening is not 'through' the panel: x1.0 and no new hole. Mirrored 1:1 by src/shared/holes-core.js GUNS (qa/paper/holes_core.test.js checks). oneShotDmg = a one-shot sniper's body damage after any card (110 x .92 = 101 kills through 1, x .85 = 93 does not through 2). crater = the one big shotgun crater per shot (mm).

wear._note: PROGRESSIVE WEAR (owner 2026-11-12; HOLES_SYSTEM.md 'Progressive wear'). Classes: P0 paper, P1 thin card (open on the first hit), P2 double card, P3 laminated / thick board, P4 solid block. Only colliders the designer flags 'noHole' stay unholeable. shots[class][gun] = shots at ONE spot until a real see-through / shoot-through hole opens (the BREACH); each hit adds ceil(full / shots) wear to the grid cells (cell mm) within the gun's brush radius (mm); below full: dent, then crack at >= crack x full (marks only, still blocks). breachR = breach hole radius x the gun's entry radius. passK = the breaching bullet keeps thinK x passK of its damage; preK = damage leaking through an UNBREACHED thick wall (very strong guns only). knife = classes the cutter can cut. 'crater' = the one shotgun crater per shot, 'blast' = paper-plane blast. Mirrored 1:1 by src/shared/holes-core.js WEAR (qa/paper/holes_core.test.js checks). No decay (persistent all match).
